name: Smith
overview: The biblical topic of 'Smith' highlights the God-given skill and wisdom bestowed upon certain individuals to craft and work with metals and materials. Tubal-cain is introduced as an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron, illustrating the early origin of metalworking expertise (Genesis 4:22). Later, God specifically calls Bezaleel and fills him with the Spirit of God, granting him wisdom, understanding, and knowledge to design and execute intricate works in gold, silver, brass, stone, and timber (Exodus 31:1-5). This divine gifting underscores that craftsmanship, especially in the context of worship and sacred service, is not merely human skill but a manifestation of God's provision and creativity.
